How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Bhubaneswar Assistant Executive Engineer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Bhubaneswar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Executive Engineer post at IIT Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Assistant Executive Engineer position at IIT Bhubaneswar is 17-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Executive Engineer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with a minimum of 6.5 CGPA or 60% marks from a recognized University or Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Assistant Executive Engineer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Executive Engineer post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Executive Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 85,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Executive Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Assistant Executive Engineer post at IIT Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any experience required for the Assistant Executive Engineer position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need to have 06 years of service in HVAC related works. Experience in managing central AC/Chiller plant is desirable.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Assistant Executive Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Test and/or Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Official Notification PDF' link provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to send a hard copy of the application form?
faq.answer: No, a hard copy of the online application form is not required to be sent to the Institute.
